messages:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for inference-api v2.3.0 -> canary=10% (region: us-west). monitor: latency, 5xx, mem.
deploy-bot: Canary monitor alert: 5xx rate at 2.8% (>1.0% threshold). latency p95 up 120ms vs baseline. tagging for review.
sre-anna: saw the alert, pulling canary traces. errors look like KV cache misses + OOM on one replica.
dev-lead-maya: ack. any DB migrations in this release? I thought we only included a migrate-only flag.
pm-noah: there was a small telemetry migration (async) but it was behind feature flag. no schema changes.
ryan: quick sanity: any dedicated customers pinned to this canary hostpool? we should avoid impacting reserved capacity.
sre-anna: no pinned dedicated customers on the affected hostpool, just hosted traffic. good.
sre-anna: automated rollback is ENABLED, but the deploy job shows "deferred-auto-rollback: true" because of migration marker present. that means we need manual rollback if we want to revert now.
dev-lead-maya: hmm. why deferred? migration marker was set by CI for the telemetry job earlier; it shouldn't block automated rollback for canary failure.
ops-bot: CI note: telemetry-migration job finished at 1773204000, marker: present. (run-id: ci-8847)
sre-anna: we can either: 1) manually trigger rollback to v2.2.9, or 2) patch the canary to 5% -> 0% (abort) which will drain canary and stop rollout. manual rollback gives full revert across regions.
pm-noah: what's the downtime / risk for manual rollback? any double-run migrations? there shouldn't be DB writes in the telemetry migration.
dev-lead-maya: rollback command: ```redwoodctl release rollback --service inference-api --from v2.3.0 --to v2.2.9 --region us-west``` Will revert replicas and config. follow with `redwoodctl rollout status --service inference-api`.
sre-anna: I recommend manual rollback. automation blocked, and the canary is already causing errors. I'll coordinate with oncall.
ryan: I'll handle customer pin/announcements for Dedicated if needed. update status page and slack #status.
pm-noah: also let's pin automatic fallback model (if inference uses model variants) to the previous quantized variant until we investigate.
sre-anna: ok I'll run rollback in 2 minutes unless objections. will broadcast updates.
dev-lead-maya: go for it. I'll standby for logs and will open a quick postmortem ticket.
sre-anna: running: `redwoodctl release rollback --service inference-api --from v2.3.0 --to v2.2.9 --force --reason "canary 5xx spike"`
deploy-bot: Rollback initiated by sre-anna for inference-api: reverting to v2.2.9. streaming events.
deploy-bot: draining canary traffic from affected hosts.
deploy-bot: Rolling back replicas: 3/3 -> 2/3 -> 1/3.
ops-bot: Status page updated: "Investigating elevated error rates on inference-api canary. Rolling back v2.3.0 to mitigate. No customer data at risk." (ticket #INC-6371)
ryan: emailed Dedicated contacts list with short note and ETA for rollback completion.
sre-anna: rollback completed in us-west. monitoring shows 5xx dropped to 0.1%, latency p95 back near baseline.
deploy-bot: Rollback complete: inference-api now at v2.2.9 in us-west. Canary aborted.
pm-noah: thanks. please don't merge v2.3.0 until we identify root cause. open branch-blocker flag.
dev-lead-maya: created PR block and issue: "v2.3.0 canary 5xx root cause investigation". assigning to infra and runtime teams.
sre-anna: quick findings: memory pressure on model runner due to new attention kernel with a stray allocation path. reproducing locally.
ryan: leaving a note for customers who saw increased latency earlier. ops-bot: scheduled email follow-up in 1h to the on-call list.
pm-noah: we'll plan a constrained re-rollout after patch + local stress tests. change window: propose tomorrow 02:00-04:00 UTC.
dev-lead-maya: agreed. add more aggressive canary gating and automatic abort flag removed.
pm-noah: retrospective and checklist: remove deferred-auto-rollback behavior when only telemetry markers present. open change request.
sre-anna: thanks team. marking this thread resolved. :white_check_mark:
pm-noah: follow-up: postmortem owner: dev-lead-maya. please include timeline and mitigation steps. closing communication loop."
